newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran youths ignore warnings over firecrackers.
newsitem.headline: Iran youths ignore warnings over firecrackers.

text.p: Police arrested scores of youths as thousands of young people defied government warnings and let off firecrackers in the Iranian capital on Tuesday night to celebrate an ancient festival.

Residents said police arrested youths to stop the traditional Chaharshanbe-Suri celebrations deemed too dangerous by the authorities because of the large number of people injured and maimed by firecrackers every year.
The festival dates back to Iran's Zoroastrian past when fire was thought to have a spiritual cleansing effect.
Fire engines stood in city squares to put out blazes expected to be started during the festival, which is held on the eve of the last Wednesday of the Iranian year. The Iranian year ends this week.
Authorities have tried with little success to limit the celebrations due to safety concerns and because of the scenes of public dancing deemed immoral under Iran's Islamic laws.
Hardline conservative newspapers have blasted the festival which they see as a pagan relic.
